description: For fixed natural arities \(m,n\), there is a primitive-recursive operation sending a program index \(e\) and an \(m\)-tuple \(a\) to an index whose evaluation on the list code of an \(n\)-tuple \(x\) equals \(\varphi_e\) on the list code of the concatenated tuple \(a,x\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.UniversalComputation.tuple_specialization {m n : ℕ} :
  ∃ s,
    Primrec₂ s ∧
      ∀ (e : ℕ) (a : List.Vector ℕ m) (x : List.Vector ℕ n),
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.UniversalComputation.phi (s e a) (Encodable.encode x.toList) =
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.UniversalComputation.phi e (Encodable.encode (a.toList ++ x.toList))
